VARIANCE PAYS.condition: PRIMARY and SECONDARY at both seeds
VARIANCE PAYS.next: the two-seed speed average joins `forward_infer`; next, distil it into one T (a train-time arm under its own PREREG) so the deployed model needs one T

PARTIAL.condition: PRIMARY < 0 and separated at both seeds but above −F
PARTIAL.next: report CAPTURE; next: a temporal average of T's own speed cells over its last ticks (single model, zero training), under its own PREREG

BIAS, NOT VARIANCE.condition: PRIMARY not separated at either seed
BIAS, NOT VARIANCE.next: T's speed error is systematic; next: a T-side speed-head arm that targets bias (a re-weighted or class-balanced speed loss), under its own PREREG

MIXED.next: reported per seed; seeds before windows

committed_next: reported per seed; seeds before windows
